authority: UI-facing 3D MT top surface layer now reads the full-density top-contact support artifact observed in top_contact_surface manifest/stats/provenance and wired through projects/utah-forge/project.json.

inputs.notes: Top surface reads the source-derived full-density tile set, not the 90,000-point preview.

producedBy.notes: Script derives top contact from processed full-density tile binaries and does not read raw archived source bytes.

crs.scene: scene-local meters, X east, Y north, Z up, origin easting 341467.35, northing 4273374.5, elevation 0
crs.notes: Provenance records source CRS and scene-local transform. Acceptance still requires spatial/visual review.

units.notes: Top surface is an approximate support mesh, not a scalar resistivity color/legend artifact.

scalar.transform: top-contact log10 resistivity preserved as per-vertex scalar metadata
scalar.notes: Visible top-surface colors encode contact elevation; scalar metadata keeps the top-contact resistivity values available for later style work.

processing.method: Full-density MT top-contact support surface. Direct observed cells retain the highest source-derived cell center; missing nodes across the full data-point XY extent are filled from nearby observed top contacts for renderable support.
processing.downsampling: Regular full-extent support grid generated from the processed full-density tile set for renderability; this is not the older 90,000-point preview-derived cap.
processing.masking: Support grid spans the full full-density data-point XY bounds. Direct observed top-contact cells are preserved where available; missing nodes are inverse-distance support estimates from nearby observed top contacts.
processing.notes: Top contact is expanded to the full data-point extent. Edge and gap-filled support nodes are lower-confidence display support, not new measured or interpreted surface data.

stats.notes: Counts, bounds, support-grid coverage, and control points are observed in top_contact_surface stats evidence.

render.colorRamp: top-contact elevation colors, not resistivity colors
render.materialNotes: Material/depth behavior, opacity, spatial alignment, camera/page framing, and caveat visibility require visual review.
render.notes: Material/depth behavior, opacity, spatial alignment, camera/page framing, and caveat visibility require visual review.

provenance.notes: Existing provenance says ready for demo preview but not final spatial analysis. This wrapper does not promote acceptance.

limitations: Top surface is the source-derived full-density MT model top contact plus full-extent render support, not measured terrain.
Support-grid nodes outside directly observed top-contact cells are lower-confidence inverse-distance estimates for visualization coverage.
Do not represent as public topo, lidar, DEM terrain, interpreted geology, wells, faults, seismic, target, resource estimate, or accepted surface interpretation.
Material/depth behavior, opacity, visibility, page role, and visual receipt require review.
Do not simplify, recolor, hide, or promote this surface without review.

questions: Does the UI-facing 3D MT top surface reach the furthest visible full-density MT top envelope in the current scene?
What caveat language is required so it is not mistaken for terrain or interpreted geology?
Which fixed cartographic datum/control points should be used for later non-digital verification?
What visual receipt proves material/depth behavior, opacity, spatial alignment, and camera/page role are acceptable?

notes: UI-facing top-surface wrapper records that the visible 3D MT top surface now uses the full-density top-contact support artifact. The older preview-derived cap remains retained under resistivity_model/top_surface as data-history support, not the current visible top-surface endpoint.
